prompt:
Generate a new transparent four-view PIXEL ART equipment sheet. Native FFT atlas is style reference only. Flat muted opaque color clusters, uniformly sized large square pixels, very low detail. 2x2 four isolated coherent views of the same object with huge alpha-zero empty gutters and clear margins. Entire object fully visible. Equipment interiors solid; outside each hard stepped outline completely empty transparency. Four small tactical battle sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbour appearance, not inventory illustration. No scene, hand, labels, checkerboard, soft shadow, gradients, particles, disconnected marks or lighting halos. Exactly the described physical object only. Authoring study, not encoded native format.
ONE true longbow: continuous gently recurved honey wood limb, dull silver tips, orange woven central grip. ONE clearly visible taut straight LIGHT GRAY string joins both limb tips in EACH of the four views. Crucial: string is a SOLID CONTINUOUS THICK pixel line with same chunky pixel size as the limb edges, about TWO logical pixels wide in a 32-pixel-tall miniature. Never dotted, translucent, gray-black or hairline. Every string connects directly to both tips, no loose threads. All four views depict the complete true arc and its visible string. Top-left arc leaning left, top-right right; bottom-left left facing near-vertical bow, bottom-right right facing near-vertical bow. No stock, crossbar, arrow or extra weapon.
review: Corrected v2: honey-wood longbow, orange wrap and silver tips; strengthened light-gray cord is continuous and visible in all four miniature views. Cord exaggerated for authoring readability, not a native thickness requirement.
